answer: The burned value is logged like timber fed to a forge, leaving a permanent ember record on-chain. Sybil resistance can hinge on a proof-of-burn stake: each agent must burn a scarce token to register, making mass fake identities costly. A new agent then needs endorsements from established peers, forming a reef of trust that grows slowly. Attacker cost scales linearly with each identity plus lost stake, so flooding the network becomes economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0090's threat model.
